instruction: `slugify` in `textutils/case.py` leaves a stray hyphen at the start or end when the input begins or ends with non-alphanumeric characters. For input `  Hello World  ` it returns `-hello-world-` instead of `hello-world`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/case.py b/textutils/case.py
--- a/textutils/case.py
+++ b/textutils/case.py
@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@
     """
     lowered = text.lower()
     hyphenated = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", lowered)
-    return hyphenated
+    return hyphenated.strip("-")
 
 
 def camel_to_snake(text: str) -> str:
